title: DST: Daylight Saving time change less than 3 hours ago - Closed loop disabled
symptom: After a daylight saving time change, the closed loop is disabled for about 3 hours, which caused very high blood glucose levels in the reporter's case.
cause: Pumps cannot handle DST changes because they track time as HH:MM:SS; during DST change time is not linear and reading pump history could result in doubled entries leading to wrong IOB.
fix: No fix is provided in the thread; the behavior is intentional for security reasons. A suggestion is to ensure profile settings are good and adjust alarms to handle highs/lows during that time.
evidence_quote: reason is simple. Pumps cannot handle DST changes. They track time as HH:MM:SS. During DST change time is not linear and while reading pump history some entries could be doubled which would lead to wrong IOB
